label: D2 arrival at S2 after an unrewarded previous trial
explanation: Reset-gate unit that fires almost only at D2 when the state input is S2 (89% of activation mass; never at GO, never at D2 with S1). Within S2 arrivals it strongly prefers trials whose previous outcome (seen at this trial D1) was no reward (prev_reward 0: 86% of mass), regardless of whether S2 was reached by a2-common or a1-rare. Predicate D2 & S2 & prev_reward==0 gives dev F1 0.64, mass recall 0.85; D2 & S2 alone has recall 0.84 but precision 0.24. Remaining ~11% of mass is weak D1 activity (mostly after no reward). Firing rate falls steadily with episode trial (55% on trial 0, ~2% after trial 70), which limits precision late in episodes; restricting to ep_trial<50/70 raises precision to ~0.7 but cuts recall. Uses only observed variables (state at D2 is the current input, prev_reward was seen at D1).
